description: A logical grouping of endpoints that share common interfaces and ownership.

id.description: The unique identifier for the endpoint group

name.description: The name of the endpoint group

ownerId.description: The ID of the owner of the endpoint group

memberEndpointIds.description: List of member endpoint IDs of the endpoint group

interfaces.description: List of interfaces supported by the endpoint group

etag.description: Opaque strong entity tag of this group version, for example `"12"`. It changes on any committed write to the group, its group routes or its relationships. Send it as `If-Match` (or as the operation `etag` in `/endpoint-groups-manage`) when mutating the group.

redirectedFrom.description: Set when the group was read through a merged-away ID: the ID that was requested, which now redirects to this group. Mutations must use this group's `id`.

parentGroupId.description: The canonical parent group derived from `IS_PART_OF` relationships, when the group has one.

childGroupIds.description: Canonical child groups derived from `IS_PART_OF` relationships.

controllers.description: Endpoints that declare `CAN_CONTROL` on one of this group's group routes, with the messages they support on it.

attributes.description: The group's state: every attribute value stored for its group routes, one entry per group route and attribute, tagged with the group route and provider. Populated only when the read is called with `expand=interfaces.attributes`.
